remarks: Enjoy downtown Stamford living in this luxury 2 BR, 2 BA condo featuring modern design and high end finishes. The gourmet kitchen with top-of-the-line appliances and elegant living room are filled with natural light and city views from the wall of windows and slider opening out to the private balcony. The primary suite is a relaxing retreat, beautifully designed with a walk-in closet and ensuite bath. Hayes House offers a staffed front desk, a fitness center, community room, and outdoor common area. 1 garage parking space included. Just steps from transportation and close to Stamford restaurants and shopping, Greenwich, and Darien.
